[P2] Recheck histories already terminal in the frozen capture

The settlement-time filter skips history comparisons when retirement acknowledges settlement after the observation window, even if the frozen history was already terminal. In the normal-return fixture, the window ends at 200 and settlement is recorded at 210; changing only the retirement history's successful execution result therefore produces no finding. The final audit reads the frozen history and cannot catch the contradiction. Include executions with frozen terminal histories in reconciliation regardless of acknowledgment time, while preserving the allowance for executions still running at freeze.
